qa_pair.question: Among the projects whose status is active, exactly one has a note that does not link to any other note. What is the job role of the person who owns that project?
The team's Lead Researcher owns exactly one project that is still active. How many distinct notes link to or embed that project's note? Answer with a number only.

The kickoff meeting quotes a single paragraph of a project note by embedding it. What spending limit, in euros, does that paragraph state? Answer with digits only, without separators or a currency sign.
The groundwater pilot project note embeds one section of a reference procedure. What is the first sub-section heading inside that embedded section? Give the heading text only.
Lena Fischer has written up a lot of field visits. How many of her visits were to monitoring stations along the Birke? Answer with a number only.

Visit reports name the replacement components that were fitted, and most of those components have no note of their own in the vault yet. Of the components without a note, which one was fitted in the most visit reports? Give its name exactly as written in the reports.
In which calendar month were the most field visits carried out? Answer in the form YYYY-MM.

Visit reports flag problems with a nested tag, one per kind of problem. At the stations on the Corra river, which kind of problem was flagged most often? Answer with the kind only, as written after the slash in the tag.

Several monitoring stations have been decommissioned. For the one decommissioned most recently, what zero-offset correction was recorded the last time it was calibrated? Answer with the number exactly as recorded, for example -0.05.
Some visit reports say the water inlet was blocked by debris. The technician who wrote the earliest such report belongs to which team?
